<div style="font-family:Arial, sans-serif; line-height:1.5; color:#333;">

    <!-- Council Meetings -->
    <div style="background:#f5faf5; border-left:4px solid #2e7d32; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:16px; border-radius:4px;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; color:#2e7d32; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Council Meetings
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Council meetings are conducted on the <strong>third Tuesday of every month commencing at 6:00pm</strong>. Meetings are held in the Council Chambers and are open to the public, with the exception of when an item is dealt with in closed meeting. The Council meeting agenda is available on Council’s website on the Thursday preceding the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">
            Council meetings are live streamed and recordings are available on Council’s YouTube channel.
        </p>

        <a href="https://www.sorell.tas.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Council-Meeting-Schedule-2026.pdf"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#2e7d32; border:1px solid #2e7d32; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 6px 6px 0;">
            2026 Meeting Schedule
        </a>

        <a href="https://www.sorell.tas.gov.au/public-question-time-at-council-meetings/"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#2e7d32; border:1px solid #2e7d32; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 6px 6px 0;">
            Public Question Time
        </a>

        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5cTJQDJ8uYClA4ocxvB5ow/featured"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#b71c1c; border:1px solid #b71c1c; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 0 6px 0;">
            Watch on YouTube
        </a>

    </div>

    <!-- SPA Meetings -->
    <div style="background:#f4f9fc; border-left:4px solid #005f7f; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:16px; border-radius:4px;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; color:#005f7f; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Sorell Planning Authority (SPA) Meetings
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Sorell Planning Authority meetings are held on Tuesdays at <strong>4:30pm</strong> at the Sorell Council Offices when required. Meetings are advertised in <em>The Mercury</em> on the Wednesday prior to the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            The purpose of SPA meetings is for Council, acting as the Planning Authority, to determine planning applications for which delegation has not been provided. Meetings are open to the public and the agenda is available on Council’s website on the Thursday preceding the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">
            SPA meetings are live streamed and recordings are available on Council’s YouTube channel.
        </p>

        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5cTJQDJ8uYClA4ocxvB5ow/featured"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#005f7f; border:1px solid #005f7f; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Watch on YouTube
        </a>

        <div style="background:#fff5f5; border-left:4px solid #b71c1c; padding:9px 11px; border-radius:3px; font-size:14px;">
            <strong style="color:#b71c1c;">Please note:</strong>
            There is no public question time allocated in SPA meetings.
        </div>

    </div>

    <!-- Meeting Agendas and Minutes -->
    <div style="margin:18px 0 10px 0;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Meeting Agendas and Minutes
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0;">
            Use the search feature below to find minutes and agendas for upcoming and past Council meetings, including SPA Meetings and AGMs. If you require minutes or agendas from meetings not published below, please contact us to request a copy.
        </p>

    </div>

<div style="font-family:Arial, sans-serif; line-height:1.5; color:#333;">

    <!-- Council Meetings -->
    <div style="background:#f5faf5; border-left:4px solid #2e7d32; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:16px; border-radius:4px;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; color:#2e7d32; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Council Meetings
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Council meetings are conducted on the <strong>third Tuesday of every month commencing at 6:00pm</strong>. Meetings are held in the Council Chambers and are open to the public, with the exception of when an item is dealt with in closed meeting. The Council meeting agenda is available on Council’s website on the Thursday preceding the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">
            Council meetings are live streamed and recordings are available on Council’s YouTube channel.
        </p>

        <a href="https://www.sorell.tas.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Council-Meeting-Schedule-2026.pdf"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#2e7d32; border:1px solid #2e7d32; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 6px 6px 0;">
            2026 Meeting Schedule
        </a>

        <a href="https://www.sorell.tas.gov.au/public-question-time-at-council-meetings/"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#2e7d32; border:1px solid #2e7d32; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 6px 6px 0;">
            Public Question Time
        </a>

        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5cTJQDJ8uYClA4ocxvB5ow/featured"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#b71c1c; border:1px solid #b71c1c; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 0 6px 0;">
            Watch on YouTube
        </a>

    </div>

    <!-- SPA Meetings -->
    <div style="background:#f4f9fc; border-left:4px solid #005f7f; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:16px; border-radius:4px;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; color:#005f7f; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Sorell Planning Authority (SPA) Meetings
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Sorell Planning Authority meetings are held on Tuesdays at <strong>4:30pm</strong> at the Sorell Council Offices when required. Meetings are advertised in <em>The Mercury</em> on the Wednesday prior to the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            The purpose of SPA meetings is for Council, acting as the Planning Authority, to determine planning applications for which delegation has not been provided. Meetings are open to the public and the agenda is available on Council’s website on the Thursday preceding the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">
            SPA meetings are live streamed and recordings are available on Council’s YouTube channel.
        </p>

        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5cTJQDJ8uYClA4ocxvB5ow/featured"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#005f7f; border:1px solid #005f7f; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Watch on YouTube
        </a>

        <div style="background:#fff5f5; border-left:4px solid #b71c1c; padding:9px 11px; border-radius:3px; font-size:14px;">
            <strong style="color:#b71c1c;">Please note:</strong>
            There is no public question time allocated in SPA meetings.
        </div>

    </div>

    <!-- Meeting Agendas and Minutes -->
    <div style="margin:18px 0 10px 0;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Meeting Agendas and Minutes
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0;">
            Use the search feature below to find minutes and agendas for upcoming and past Council meetings, including SPA Meetings and AGMs. If you require minutes or agendas from meetings not published below, please contact us to request a copy.
        </p>

    </div>

<div style="font-family:Arial, sans-serif; line-height:1.5; color:#333;">

    <!-- Council Meetings -->
    <div style="background:#f5faf5; border-left:4px solid #2e7d32; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:16px; border-radius:4px;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; color:#2e7d32; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Council Meetings
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Council meetings are conducted on the <strong>third Tuesday of every month commencing at 6:00pm</strong>. Meetings are held in the Council Chambers and are open to the public, with the exception of when an item is dealt with in closed meeting. The Council meeting agenda is available on Council’s website on the Thursday preceding the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">
            Council meetings are live streamed and recordings are available on Council’s YouTube channel.
        </p>

        <a href="https://www.sorell.tas.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Council-Meeting-Schedule-2026.pdf"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#2e7d32; border:1px solid #2e7d32; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 6px 6px 0;">
            2026 Meeting Schedule
        </a>

        <a href="https://www.sorell.tas.gov.au/public-question-time-at-council-meetings/"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#2e7d32; border:1px solid #2e7d32; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 6px 6px 0;">
            Public Question Time
        </a>

        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5cTJQDJ8uYClA4ocxvB5ow/featured"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#b71c1c; border:1px solid #b71c1c; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 0 6px 0;">
            Watch on YouTube
        </a>

    </div>

    <!-- SPA Meetings -->
    <div style="background:#f4f9fc; border-left:4px solid #005f7f; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:16px; border-radius:4px;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; color:#005f7f; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Sorell Planning Authority (SPA) Meetings
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Sorell Planning Authority meetings are held on Tuesdays at <strong>4:30pm</strong> at the Sorell Council Offices when required. Meetings are advertised in <em>The Mercury</em> on the Wednesday prior to the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            The purpose of SPA meetings is for Council, acting as the Planning Authority, to determine planning applications for which delegation has not been provided. Meetings are open to the public and the agenda is available on Council’s website on the Thursday preceding the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">
            SPA meetings are live streamed and recordings are available on Council’s YouTube channel.
        </p>

        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5cTJQDJ8uYClA4ocxvB5ow/featured"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#005f7f; border:1px solid #005f7f; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Watch on YouTube
        </a>

        <div style="background:#fff5f5; border-left:4px solid #b71c1c; padding:9px 11px; border-radius:3px; font-size:14px;">
            <strong style="color:#b71c1c;">Please note:</strong>
            There is no public question time allocated in SPA meetings.
        </div>

    </div>

    <!-- Meeting Agendas and Minutes -->
    <div style="margin:18px 0 10px 0;">

            Use the search feature below to find minutes and agendas for upcoming and past Council meetings, including SPA Meetings and AGMs. If you require minutes or agendas from meetings not published below, please contact us to request a copy.
        </p>

    </div>

<div style="font-family:Arial, sans-serif; line-height:1.5; color:#333;">

    <!-- Council Meetings -->
    <div style="background:#f5faf5; border-left:4px solid #2e7d32; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:16px; border-radius:4px;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; color:#2e7d32; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Council Meetings
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Council meetings are conducted on the <strong>third Tuesday of every month commencing at 6:00pm</strong>. Meetings are held in the Council Chambers and are open to the public, with the exception of when an item is dealt with in closed meeting. The Council meeting agenda is available on Council’s website on the Thursday preceding the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">
            Council meetings are live streamed and recordings are available on Council’s YouTube channel.
        </p>

        <a href="https://www.sorell.tas.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Council-Meeting-Schedule-2026.pdf"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#2e7d32; border:1px solid #2e7d32; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 6px 6px 0;">
            2026 Meeting Schedule
        </a>

        <a href="https://www.sorell.tas.gov.au/public-question-time-at-council-meetings/"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#2e7d32; border:1px solid #2e7d32; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 6px 6px 0;">
            Public Question Time
        </a>

        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5cTJQDJ8uYClA4ocxvB5ow/featured"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#b71c1c; border:1px solid #b71c1c; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 0 6px 0;">
            Watch on YouTube
        </a>

    </div>

    <!-- SPA Meetings -->
    <div style="background:#f4f9fc; border-left:4px solid #005f7f; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:16px; border-radius:4px;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; color:#005f7f; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Sorell Planning Authority (SPA) Meetings
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Sorell Planning Authority meetings are held on Tuesdays at <strong>4:30pm</strong> at the Sorell Council Offices when required. Meetings are advertised in <em>The Mercury</em> on the Wednesday prior to the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            The purpose of SPA meetings is for Council, acting as the Planning Authority, to determine planning applications for which delegation has not been provided. Meetings are open to the public and the agenda is available on Council’s website on the Thursday preceding the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">
            SPA meetings are live streamed and recordings are available on Council’s YouTube channel.
        </p>

        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5cTJQDJ8uYClA4ocxvB5ow/featured"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#005f7f; border:1px solid #005f7f; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Watch on YouTube
        </a>

        <div style="background:#fff5f5; border-left:4px solid #b71c1c; padding:9px 11px; border-radius:3px; font-size:14px;">
            <strong style="color:#b71c1c;">Please note:</strong>
            There is no public question time allocated in SPA meetings.
        </div>

    </div>

    <!-- Meeting Agendas and Minutes -->
    <div style="margin:18px 0 10px 0;">

            Use the search feature below to find minutes and agendas for upcoming and past Council meetings, including SPA Meetings and AGMs. If you require minutes or agendas from meetings not published below, please contact us to request a copy.
        </p>

<div style="font-family:Arial, sans-serif; line-height:1.5; color:#333;">

    <!-- Council Meetings -->
    <div style="background:#f5faf5; border-left:4px solid #2e7d32; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:16px; border-radius:4px;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; color:#2e7d32; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Council Meetings
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Council meetings are conducted on the <strong>third Tuesday of every month commencing at 6:00pm</strong>. Meetings are held in the Council Chambers and are open to the public, with the exception of when an item is dealt with in closed meeting. The Council meeting agenda is available on Council’s website on the Thursday preceding the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">
            Council meetings are live streamed and recordings are available on Council’s YouTube channel.
        </p>

        <a href="https://www.sorell.tas.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Council-Meeting-Schedule-2026.pdf"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#2e7d32; border:1px solid #2e7d32; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 6px 6px 0;">
            2026 Meeting Schedule
        </a>

        <a href="https://www.sorell.tas.gov.au/public-question-time-at-council-meetings/"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#2e7d32; border:1px solid #2e7d32; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 6px 6px 0;">
            Public Question Time
        </a>

        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5cTJQDJ8uYClA4ocxvB5ow/featured"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#b71c1c; border:1px solid #b71c1c; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 0 6px 0;">
            Watch on YouTube
        </a>

    </div>

    <!-- SPA Meetings -->
    <div style="background:#f4f9fc; border-left:4px solid #005f7f; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:16px; border-radius:4px;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; color:#005f7f; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Sorell Planning Authority (SPA) Meetings
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Sorell Planning Authority meetings are held on Tuesdays at <strong>4:30pm</strong> at the Sorell Council Offices when required. Meetings are advertised in <em>The Mercury</em> on the Wednesday prior to the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            The purpose of SPA meetings is for Council, acting as the Planning Authority, to determine planning applications for which delegation has not been provided. Meetings are open to the public and the agenda is available on Council’s website on the Thursday preceding the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">
            SPA meetings are live streamed and recordings are available on Council’s YouTube channel.
        </p>

        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5cTJQDJ8uYClA4ocxvB5ow/featured"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#005f7f; border:1px solid #005f7f; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Watch on YouTube
        </a>

        <div style="background:#fff5f5; border-left:4px solid #b71c1c; padding:9px 11px; border-radius:3px; font-size:14px;">
            <strong style="color:#b71c1c;">Please note:</strong>
            There is no public question time allocated in SPA meetings.
        </div>

    </div>

    <!-- Meeting Agendas and Minutes -->
    <div style="margin:18px 0 10px 0;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Meeting Agendas and Minutes
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0;">
            Use the search feature below to find minutes and agendas for upcoming and past Council meetings, including SPA Meetings and AGMs. If you require minutes or agendas from meetings not published below, please contact us to request a copy.
        </p>

    </div>

            Council Meetings
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Council meetings are conducted on the <strong>third Tuesday of every month commencing at 6:00pm</strong>. Meetings are held in the Council Chambers and are open to the public, with the exception of when an item is dealt with in closed meeting. The Council meeting agenda is available on Council’s website on the Thursday preceding the meeting.
        </p>

            Council meetings are live streamed and recordings are available on Council’s YouTube channel.
        </p>

    <div style="background:#f4f9fc; border-left:4px solid #005f7f; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:16px; border-radius:4px;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; color:#005f7f; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Sorell Planning Authority (SPA) Meetings
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Sorell Planning Authority meetings are held on Tuesdays at <strong>4:30pm</strong> at the Sorell Council Offices when required. Meetings are advertised in <em>The Mercury</em> on the Wednesday prior to the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            The purpose of SPA meetings is for Council, acting as the Planning Authority, to determine planning applications for which delegation has not been provided. Meetings are open to the public and the agenda is available on Council’s website on the Thursday preceding the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">
            SPA meetings are live streamed and recordings are available on Council’s YouTube channel.
        </p>

        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5cTJQDJ8uYClA4ocxvB5ow/featured"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#005f7f; border:1px solid #005f7f; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Watch on YouTube
        </a>

        <div style="background:#fff5f5; border-left:4px solid #b71c1c; padding:9px 11px; border-radius:3px; font-size:14px;">
            <strong style="color:#b71c1c;">Please note:</strong>
            There is no public question time allocated in SPA meetings.
        </div>

    </div>

                            <h1 itemprop="name">Meetings & Minutes</h1>

                            <div itemprop="articleBody">
                                
<div style="font-family:Arial, sans-serif; line-height:1.5; color:#333;">

    <!-- Council Meetings -->
    <div style="background:#f5faf5; border-left:4px solid #2e7d32; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:16px; border-radius:4px;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; color:#2e7d32; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Council Meetings
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Council meetings are conducted on the <strong>third Tuesday of every month commencing at 6:00pm</strong>. Meetings are held in the Council Chambers and are open to the public, with the exception of when an item is dealt with in closed meeting. The Council meeting agenda is available on Council’s website on the Thursday preceding the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">
            Council meetings are live streamed and recordings are available on Council’s YouTube channel.

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; color:#005f7f; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Sorell Planning Authority (SPA) Meetings
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Sorell Planning Authority meetings are held on Tuesdays at <strong>4:30pm</strong> at the Sorell Council Offices when required. Meetings are advertised in <em>The Mercury</em> on the Wednesday prior to the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            The purpose of SPA meetings is for Council, acting as the Planning Authority, to determine planning applications for which delegation has not been provided. Meetings are open to the public and the agenda is available on Council’s website on the Thursday preceding the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">
            SPA meetings are live streamed and recordings are available on Council’s YouTube channel.
        </p>

        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5cTJQDJ8uYClA4ocxvB5ow/featured"
           target="_blank"

            <strong style="color:#b71c1c;">Please note:</strong>
            There is no public question time allocated in SPA meetings.
        </div>

                            <h1 itemprop="name">Meetings & Minutes</h1>

                            <div itemprop="articleBody">
                                
<div style="font-family:Arial, sans-serif; line-height:1.5; color:#333;">

    <!-- Council Meetings -->
    <div style="background:#f5faf5; border-left:4px solid #2e7d32; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:16px; border-radius:4px;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; color:#2e7d32; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Council Meetings
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Council meetings are conducted on the <strong>third Tuesday of every month commencing at 6:00pm</strong>. Meetings are held in the Council Chambers and are open to the public, with the exception of when an item is dealt with in closed meeting. The Council meeting agenda is available on Council’s website on the Thursday preceding the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">
            Council meetings are live streamed and recordings are available on Council’s YouTube channel.
        </p>

        <a href="https://www.sorell.tas.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Council-Meeting-Schedule-2026.pdf"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#2e7d32; border:1px solid #2e7d32; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 6px 6px 0;">
            2026 Meeting Schedule
        </a>

        <a href="https://www.sorell.tas.gov.au/public-question-time-at-council-meetings/"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#2e7d32; border:1px solid #2e7d32; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 6px 6px 0;">
            Public Question Time
        </a>

        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5cTJQDJ8uYClA4ocxvB5ow/featured"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#b71c1c; border:1px solid #b71c1c; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 0 6px 0;">
            Watch on YouTube
        </a>

    </div>

    <!-- SPA Meetings -->
    <div style="background:#f4f9fc; border-left:4px solid #005f7f; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:16px; border-radius:4px;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; color:#005f7f; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Sorell Planning Authority (SPA) Meetings
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Sorell Planning Authority meetings are held on Tuesdays at <strong>4:30pm</strong> at the Sorell Council Offices when required. Meetings are advertised in <em>The Mercury</em> on the Wednesday prior to the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            The purpose of SPA meetings is for Council, acting as the Planning Authority, to determine planning applications for which delegation has not been provided. Meetings are open to the public and the agenda is available on Council’s website on the Thursday preceding the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">
            SPA meetings are live streamed and recordings are available on Council’s YouTube channel.
        </p>

        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5cTJQDJ8uYClA4ocxvB5ow/featured"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#005f7f; border:1px solid #005f7f; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Watch on YouTube
        </a>

        <div style="background:#fff5f5; border-left:4px solid #b71c1c; padding:9px 11px; border-radius:3px; font-size:14px;">
            <strong style="color:#b71c1c;">Please note:</strong>
            There is no public question time allocated in SPA meetings.
        </div>

    </div>

                            <h1 itemprop="name">Meetings & Minutes</h1>

                            <div itemprop="articleBody">
                                
<div style="font-family:Arial, sans-serif; line-height:1.5; color:#333;">

    <!-- Council Meetings -->
    <div style="background:#f5faf5; border-left:4px solid #2e7d32; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:16px; border-radius:4px;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; color:#2e7d32; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Council Meetings
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Council meetings are conducted on the <strong>third Tuesday of every month commencing at 6:00pm</strong>. Meetings are held in the Council Chambers and are open to the public, with the exception of when an item is dealt with in closed meeting. The Council meeting agenda is available on Council’s website on the Thursday preceding the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">
            Council meetings are live streamed and recordings are available on Council’s YouTube channel.
        </p>

        <a href="https://www.sorell.tas.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Council-Meeting-Schedule-2026.pdf"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#2e7d32; border:1px solid #2e7d32; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 6px 6px 0;">
            2026 Meeting Schedule
        </a>

        <a href="https://www.sorell.tas.gov.au/public-question-time-at-council-meetings/"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#2e7d32; border:1px solid #2e7d32; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 6px 6px 0;">
            Public Question Time
        </a>

        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5cTJQDJ8uYClA4ocxvB5ow/featured"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#b71c1c; border:1px solid #b71c1c; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 0 6px 0;">
            Watch on YouTube
        </a>

    </div>

    <!-- SPA Meetings -->
    <div style="background:#f4f9fc; border-left:4px solid #005f7f; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:16px; border-radius:4px;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; color:#005f7f; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Sorell Planning Authority (SPA) Meetings
        </h3>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Sorell Planning Authority meetings are held on Tuesdays at <strong>4:30pm</strong> at the Sorell Council Offices when required. Meetings are advertised in <em>The Mercury</em> on the Wednesday prior to the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            The purpose of SPA meetings is for Council, acting as the Planning Authority, to determine planning applications for which delegation has not been provided. Meetings are open to the public and the agenda is available on Council’s website on the Thursday preceding the meeting.
        </p>

        <p style="margin:0 0 12px 0;">
            SPA meetings are live streamed and recordings are available on Council’s YouTube channel.
        </p>

        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5cTJQDJ8uYClA4ocxvB5ow/featured"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener"
           style="display:inline-block; background:#ffffff; color:#005f7f; border:1px solid #005f7f; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            Watch on YouTube
        </a>

        <div style="background:#fff5f5; border-left:4px solid #b71c1c; padding:9px 11px; border-radius:3px; font-size:14px;">
            <strong style="color:#b71c1c;">Please note:</strong>
            There is no public question time allocated in SPA meetings.
        </div>

    </div>

    <!-- Meeting Agendas and Minutes -->
    <div style="margin:18px 0 10px 0;">

        <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px 0; font-size:18px; font-weight:600;">
            Meeting Agendas and Minutes
